from_speaker: AI startups that can literally not afford to pay for tokens without venture capital funding
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that both labs require payments from VC-dependent AI startup customers to sustain operations. Having important customers or concentrated revenue is insufficient by itself.
Use April–June 2026, the latest completed calendar reporting quarter before the post, for the ongoing financial condition.
The surrounding argument relies on third-party estimates of customer spending; it does not specify a survival horizon or a minimum revenue share.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable customer revenue, cash, expense and financing records show that removing payments from VC-dependent AI startups would prevent both labs from sustaining operations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that either lab could sustain operations without those payments, accounting for existing obligations and available financing.
